newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Oil shares still under selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Oil shares still under selling pressure.

text.p: Shares of Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd continued to fall on Monday morning, on the after-effects of last week's raid on the company's headquarters by Tokyo prosecutors, traders said.
Shares in Mitsui Mining Co, whose headquarters were raided by prosecutors on Friday, were also down.
The two firms were reported to have done business with Junichi Izui, an Osaka-based oil products trader arrested on Thursday on suspicion of evading 320 million yen in taxes.
At 0150 GMT, the share price of Mitsubishi Oil was down 12 yen at 818 yen, on a volume of 667,000 shares.
The share price of Mitsui Mining Co was down three yen at 512 yen as of 0152 GMT. Volume stood at 42,000 shares.
